headline: Heard appeal of trespass order for Eric Gravel involving Chocolate Thunder before moving into deliberative session.
summary: The committee held a public forum where Todd Deluca spoke in support of Eric Gravel. The committee then heard testimony from Eric Gravel and Robyn Tolin of Chocolate Thunder on a trespass order appeal before moving into deliberative session.
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Public Safety Committee 
 Wednesday, July 1, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1s Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Buddy Singh (Chair), Melo Grant, Evan Litwin, Laura Sanchez-Parkinson 
  
Staff Present: Hayley McClenahan (Assistant City Attorney), Jessica Brown (City Attorney) 
 
Public Present: Todd Deluca, Eric Gravel, Robyn Tolin 
 
Meeting called to order at 5:31 PM by Councilor Singh. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to Adopt Agenda as written.   
 
Motion by Councilor Litwin, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.    Public Forum 
      2.01 Verbal Comments 
 
Todd Deluca expressed support for appellant Eric Gravel. 
 
Public Forum closed at 5:35 PM.   
 
3.    Appeal of Trespass Order/Hearing 
      3.01 In re: Matter of Eric Gravel 
 
The Committee heard from Eric Gravel as well as Robyn Tolin of Chocolate Thunder, 
represented by City Attorney Jessica Brown.  The Committee had the opportunity to ask 
questions of both parties before moving to Deliberative Session.   
 
10.  Adjournment 
     10.01 Motion to Adjourn 
 
Motion to adjourn the public portion of the meeting and move into Deliberative Session.   
 
Motion by Councilor Litwin, Seconded by Councilor Grant 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 6:39 PM.
